name: racines-et-rituels
description: Static HTML/JS site with Stripe Checkout backend

scripts.dev:alt: npm run dev:pre && npm run dev:services
scripts.dev:services: concurrently --kill-others --names "BACKEND,FRONTEND,STRIPE,SUMMARY" -c "bgBlue.bold,bgGreen.bold,bgMagenta.bold,bgCyan.bold" "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:front" "npm run dev:stripe" "bash scripts/dev-summary.sh"
scripts.diag:front-root: ROOT=./ && echo "pwd: $(pwd)" && node -p "process.cwd()" && ls -la && ls -la $ROOT && (curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8000/js/config.js | head -n 5 || true)
scripts.kill:ports: lsof -ti :3000 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null || true && lsof -ti :8000 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.db:migrate: sh -c 'URL=${DATABASE_URL:-postgresql://postgres:postgres@127.0.0.1:54322/postgres}; for f in server/sql/*.sql; do echo "Applying $f"; psql "$URL" -f "$f"; done'
scripts.check:docker: docker info >/dev/null 2>&1 || (echo '❌ Docker non démarré' && exit 1)
